installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

VERSION="${GRAVIT_VERSION:-5.7.12}"
DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/GravitLauncher/Launcher/releases/download/v${VERSION}/LaunchServerBuild.zip"
ARCHIVE="/mnt/server/.LaunchServerBuild.zip"
INSTALL_DIR="/mnt/server/.gravit-launchserver-install"

echo "Installing GravitLauncher LaunchServer v${VERSION}"

rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl unzip
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

rm -f "${ARCHIVE}"
rm -rf "${INSTALL_DIR}"

curl -fL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" -o "${ARCHIVE}"

mkdir -p "${INSTALL_DIR}"
unzip -q "${ARCHIVE}" -d "${INSTALL_DIR}"

if [ -d "${INSTALL_DIR}/launchserver" ]; then
    SOURCE_DIR="${INSTALL_DIR}/launchserver"
else
    SOURCE_DIR="${INSTALL_DIR}"
fi

# Remove files of the previous version so stale jars do not end up on the classpath.
# Configs, profiles, updates and modules are kept.
rm -rf /mnt/server/bin /mnt/server/lib /mnt/server/launcher-libraries /mnt/server/proguard-libraries

cp -a "${SOURCE_DIR}/." /mnt/server/

# java.io.tmpdir (see startup): Pterodactyl /tmp is too small for installclient
mkdir -p /mnt/server/tmp

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/bin/launchserver ]; then
    echo "ERROR: bin/launchserver was not found after extraction"
    exit 1
fi

chmod +x /mnt/server/bin/launchserver

rm -rf "${INSTALL_DIR}"
rm -f "${ARCHIVE}"

echo "GravitLauncher LaunchServer v${VERSION} installed successfully"

variables.name: GravitLauncher Version
variables.description: GravitLauncher release to install (https://github.com/GravitLauncher/Launcher/releases). Example: 5.7.12. Reinstall the server after changing this value to update LaunchServer files; configs, profiles and updates are kept.

variables.name: External Address
variables.description: External address written to LaunchServer.json on first start. Without a domain/proxy use http://IP:PORT with the port from the server allocation (e.g. http://203.0.113.10:9274). Behind an HTTPS reverse proxy use https://launcher.example.com. Do not add /api. Later changes go to netty.address and netty.downloadURL in LaunchServer.json.

variables.name: Project Name
variables.description: Project name used when LaunchServer.json is generated for the first time.
